name: Wind Map
description: A field of moving air drawn as thousands of short fading trails, faster air brighter and longer, with speed and bearing under the pointer.

props.name: field
props.type: (x: number, y: number, t: number) => [u: number, v: number]
props.description: Your own wind. Takes a point in CSS pixels from the top left and the time in seconds, and returns the velocity in pixels per second, u to the right and v downward. Without it, a seeded field of drifting highs and lows over a westerly. The chip reads one pixel per second as 1 km/h.

props.name: particles
props.description: Particles in a 960 by 520 frame. Scaled with the area, so a small frame is not crowded.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the particles move and the field changes. The chip still shows the field's own speed.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of slow air. Faster air shifts toward ink by day and toward white at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the trails. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Layers drawn under the trails, such as a coastline or contours, and any content above them.
